newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan firms' profits seen up 11.4 pct in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Japan firms' profits seen up 11.4 pct in 1996/97.

text.p: Parent current profits at Japan's leading companies are expected to rise an average of 11.4 percent in 1996/97, New Japan Securities Co said in a report on Tuesday.
The forecast was based on a survey of 350 firms listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's first section.
The report also said the companies' parent current profits were expected to grow 10.5 percent in 1997/98.
